summary: Iteration 48 - Backend testing complete for bulk operations (events, tasks, members), boards restricted/private visibility, and public events country filter. Fixed critical route ordering bug in events.py and tasks.py. All 24 tests passed (100% success rate).
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Route ordering bug in events.py - bulk routes (/events/bulk-update, /events/bulk-delete, /events/bulk-export) were defined AFTER parameterized routes (/events/{event_id}), causing FastAPI to match 'bulk-update' as an event_id. Moved bulk routes before parameterized routes.
FIXED: Same route ordering bug in tasks.py - bulk routes moved before parameterized routes
Bulk event update (PUT /api/events/bulk-update) correctly updates status, type, location_id, visibility, capacity fields
Bulk event delete (POST /api/events/bulk-delete) correctly deletes multiple events
Bulk event export (POST /api/events/bulk-export) returns JSON array for CSV conversion
Bulk task update (PUT /api/tasks/bulk-update) correctly updates status, priority, assignees, due_date
Bulk task delete (POST /api/tasks/bulk-delete) correctly deletes multiple tasks
Bulk task archive (POST /api/tasks/bulk-archive) correctly archives/unarchives tasks
Bulk member export (POST /api/admin/members/bulk-export) returns JSON array of members
Boards with is_restricted=true only visible to tagged_members and creator
Boards with is_private=true only visible to tagged_members and creator
Public events country filter resolves country from location_id when not set on event
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix for cleanup
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 48 verified all bulk operations: (1) Bulk event update/delete/export all working, (2) Bulk task update/delete/archive all working, (3) Bulk member export working, (4) Boards restricted/private visibility working correctly - only tagged members and creator can see restricted/private boards, (5) Public events country filter resolves country from location_id. IMPORTANT: Fixed route ordering bug - bulk routes must be defined BEFORE parameterized routes in FastAPI to avoid path parameter matching issues.
